newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks shift down a gear with bonds.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks shift down a gear with bonds.

text.p: Shares in Madrid closed lower on Wednesday in a consolidation move which took its tone from the bond market, dealers said.
The general index fell 2.56 points, 0.62 percent, to 408.86 and the Ibex shed 32.65 points, 0.69 percent, to 4,724.53.
Dealers saw further upside potential evidenced by lower volume amid selling today. Turnover totalled aroun 41 billion pesetas.
Iberdrola, which rose 70 pesetas on Tuesday, shed just 5 pesetas to 1,600, while Fenosa, which had added 55 pesetas, closed flat today at 1,055.
Oil group Repsol shed 70 pesetas to 4,730.

"We've seen a bit of profit-taking in the case of Repsol, part of a move to consolidate overall in the bourse. Things medium term haven't changed and we're still positive on the market," said a trader at Benito y Monjardin.
Tomorrow's session was likely to be fairly dull, with no major market-moving indicators due and ahead of a public holiday on Friday, dealers said.
